categories.label: Locked armory
categories.note: Event: 10 of the 28 spots hold an armory at a time. Opens only with the green shipping container key. Racks for 3 M14 (it spawns nowhere else on Nasdara) and 5 AKM, each filled by chance, plus 4 to 8 military items. On DayZed.gg servers it takes no damage: it cannot be raided open.

categories.label: Brick pile
categories.note: Event: about 40 of these spots hold a pile at a time. A pile holds 252 bricks: take them off it, it shrinks as it empties and disappears when empty.

categories.label: Irrigation tunnels
categories.note: Entrance: build the rope ladder to climb down. Attach rope (a stack of 2) and 20 wooden sticks, then build it with empty hands, from the top or from inside the tunnel (one ladder at a time). It cannot be dismantled and wears down only to 30 %, but gunfire and grenades destroy it. The lines are the tunnels under the ground.
